notes.note: Name of a tile's history chart, a slider a keyboard moves through; name is the tile title. Lists the keys.

segment.source: {name} history. Left and Right step one bucket, with Shift ten; Page Up and Page Down change the resolution; Home and End go to the oldest and the newest; Escape closes the readout.
segment.target: Historik för {name}. Vänster- och högerpil flyttar en period, med Skift tio; Page Up och Page Down byter upplösning; Home och End går till den äldsta och den nyaste; Escape stänger avläsningen.

notes.note: Small label on a history chart while the pointer or the keyboard holds it still.
Label at the right end of a history chart's time axis.
Button of the live metrics that stops the motion of every history chart; the numbers keep updating.
The same button while the motion is paused.
Readout of a history chart: when a one-second bucket was (a clock time), its length and how long ago it ended.
Readout of a history chart: the start and end of a bucket (clock times), its length and how long ago it ended.
Readout of a bucket of a history chart that has no data.
Readout: the mean of a bucket longer than a second; value is a number with its unit.
Readout: the lowest and highest value within a bucket.
Readout: as the lowest and highest of a bucket, when the highest stands above the top of the chart's scale (drawn as a caret).
Readout of a one-second value above the top of the chart's scale; top is that top with its unit.
Readout note: the bucket begins before the oldest moment the chart shows.

segment.source: This bucket starts before the chart's reach; only its newer part is drawn.
segment.target: Perioden börjar före diagrammets räckvidd; bara dess nyare del ritas.

notes.note: Readout note: only part of the bucket's time had data (41 s of 1 min).
Readout note: how many of the cluster's controllers the bucket covers.
Readout note in a cluster for a figure summed over the controllers.

segment.source: Sum of the controllers: the mean is exact; the true range lies inside the lowest and highest shown.
segment.target: Summan av alla controllers: medelvärdet är exakt; det verkliga spannet ligger inom det lägsta och högsta som visas.

notes.note: Readout note in a cluster for a figure that shows the controller worst off (a latency, the lag, the CPU).

segment.source: The controller worst off: the highest is exact; the mean and the lowest are lower bounds.
segment.target: Den controller som har det sämst: det högsta är exakt; medelvärdet och det lägsta är nedre gränser.

notes.note: Readout note in a cluster for the memory and the disk: the controller with the least available.

segment.source: The controller with the smallest share available in this bucket, with its own values.
segment.target: Den controller som har minst andel ledigt under perioden, med sina egna värden.

notes.note: Readout note in a cluster for a share (the cache hit ratio, the NOERROR share).

segment.source: Recomputed from the counts of every controller; lowest and highest are those of any controller.
segment.target: Beräknad på nytt ur alla controllers antal; lägst och högst är någon enskild controllers.

notes.note: Where a single controller's history begins: it keeps the history in memory, so nothing before its start is known; time is a clock time.

segment.source: No history before {time}, when this controller started.
segment.target: Ingen historik före {time}, då denna controller startade.

notes.note: The same for one controller of a cluster; node is its number.

segment.source: Controller {node} started at {time}; its history before that is missing.
segment.target: Controller {node} startade {time}; dess historik dessförinnan saknas.

notes.note: Text alternative of a history chart, first sentence: the tile's figure now; value is a number with its unit.
Text alternative, first sentence, while the tile has no figure.
Text alternative: the range of the last minute.
Text alternative: the last minute was zero throughout.
Text alternative: the last hour's mean and its highest value with the clock time of its bucket.
Text alternative: the last hour was zero throughout.
Text alternative: the two days before the last hour, the highest value with the span of its bucket, and the lowest.

segment.source: Last 2 days: highest {highest} between {start} and {end}, lowest {lowest}.
segment.target: Senaste 2 dygnen: högst {highest} mellan {start} och {end}, lägst {lowest}.

notes.note: Text alternative: the two days before the last hour were zero throughout.
Text alternative of a chart without any history yet.
